description: Two letters from Mary Cabot Wheelwright to Irene Zelinski are also contained in this box. The letter of Dec. 19, [1955] is written from Oaxaca and mentions the arrival of Dorothy Stewart there. The letter of Jan. 10, [1957] confirms that Wheelwright will be using Wight's San Francisco apartment [see: Chabot to Zelinski – Oct. 6, 1956 and after.]
title: Mary Wheelright to Irene Zelinski
